name: singlet_evaluation_overcorrection_detection
title: Detect over-correction after batch or covariate removal
description: Detects over-correction after batch correction, integration or covariate regression: whether condition-level differential expression, cell-type structure or marker separation present before correction was removed. Needs raw counts, donor, batch, condition and cell-type labels, the uncorrected embedding and the corrected output under test. The default condition_de_retention method needs at least four donors per condition. Writes summaries, reference and post-correction DE tables and a flag under uns/overcorrection; it never corrects or refits the data. Do not use it to score cell-level integration quality alone; use the integration quality scoring tool for that.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Readout to compute. Use knn_purity, cilisi or scib_bio_conservation for cell-type structure only.

keys.description: obs columns for batch, condition, donor and cell type, and an optional uns key of marker sets.

batch.description: obs column of batch labels (at least two levels).

condition.description: obs column of the protected condition (at least two levels).

donor.description: obs column of biological replicates (donor or sample).

cell_type.description: obs column of cell-type labels fixed before correction.

marker_sets.description: uns key of marker gene sets for AUROC retention; optional.

representations.description: Storage keys of the uncorrected and corrected representations under test.

counts.description: Raw count layer for the pre-correction negative-binomial reference.

uncorrected_expression.description: Uncorrected log-scale layer for the matched linear baseline.

corrected_expression.description: Corrected log-scale expression under test; required for retention.

uncorrected_embedding.description: Uncorrected embedding for the pre-correction neighbour graph.

corrected_embedding.description: Corrected embedding under test for kSIM, CiLISI and silhouette.

condition_de_retention.description: Settings for the default retention readout.

fdr.description: FDR threshold defining the reference and post-correction gene sets.

min_abs_log_fc.description: Minimum absolute effect in each test's own units; 0 applies no filter.

min_donors_per_condition.description: Donors needed per condition within a cell type; below this the type is not evaluable.

flag_threshold.description: Flag when the over-correction score exceeds this; uncalibrated, for review.

K.description: Neighbours per cell, including the query cell.

min_rate.description: Per-cell purity threshold for the acceptance rate.

cilisi.description: Settings for the cell-type-aware LISI readout.

min_cells_split.description: Minimum cells per cell-type group for CiLISI.

min_batches_per_group.description: Minimum distinct batches per group; CiLISI needs at least two batch labels per group.

scib_bio_conservation.description: Settings for the scIB bio-conservation group.

n_hvg.description: Per-batch highly variable genes for HVG overlap, capped at half the genes.

n_comps.description: Principal components for PCR and isolated-label silhouette.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for approximate kNN construction and any subsampling.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/overcorrection/summary. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, n_reference_genes, retention_matched, retention_nb, sign_concordance, over_correction_score, flag, knn_purity_mean, knn_purity_accept_rate, cilisi, scib_bio_conservation, marker_auroc_retention. Keys not computed are absent. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
